transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Nice to meet you. Thanks for seeing me today. Um... well, to be honest, my wife kind of pushed me to make the appointment. I hope I'm not wasting your time, but... she and, well, my supervisor at the plant, they keep getting upset, saying I'm not listening to them. 

I really try to be respectful and pay attention, I promise I do! But they'll be talking right to my face, and... I don't know, a minute later I just realize I only caught maybe half of what they said. Then I have to ask them to repeat it, which I know is frustrating for them, and it's a little embarrassing for me to even admit. I just want to do a good job at work and be a good husband, you know? Does that... does that make sense for why I'd be here?
Have you noticed any trouble hearing sounds or conversations in general?

Oh, no, my hearing is actually really good. We have to do those hearing tests at the plant every year, and I always pass them with flying colors. I definitely don't want you to think I have bad ears or that I'm just ignoring people on purpose! 

I can hear the sounds and the volume just fine... it's just, well, the words just don't always stick in my head once they get in there. I'm sorry if I made it sound like a physical ear problem earlier. Am I explaining that okay?
Did these concentration and listening problems first start only in the last year or two, or have they been there since childhood?

Well, um... to be completely honest, it's not a new thing. I guess I've kind of always been like this, even back when I was a little kid. 

I hope it doesn't make me sound like I was a bad child, because I really didn't mean to be disruptive! I always wanted to make my teachers happy. But, um, they were always having to move my seat around because I just couldn't quite stay put in my chair. And I'd get a little too eager and just call out answers without raising my hand... and sometimes I'd get into a little bit of trouble for butting into other kids' work. This was all way back before middle school, mostly. 

I was just a really energetic kid, I think. I really tried my best to be good, though, I promise. Is that... does that help answer your question? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
